resume: 8-voice synth after the Roland S-1 and the SH-101: sub-oscillator, resonant 4-pole filter, bass and lead sounds, with OSC DRAW and OSC CHOP. 64 factory presets (1 to 64), slots 65 to 99 are for your own.

commandes.role: Lowers the keyboard by at most three octaves. With OCT+ at the same time, returns to octave 0.
Raises the keyboard by at most three octaves. With OCT- at the same time, returns to octave 0.
Pages MIX, DELAY and REV / CHO (chorus, delay, reverb). Held, sets the chorus, delay and reverb levels directly on the knobs.
Pages ENVELOPE (attack, decay, sustain, release) then ENV / PWM (trigger and amplitude mode).
Pages LFO (speed, shape, sync, Fast mode), LFO MOD (depths) and RISER.
Pages OSC CORE, OSC PWM, SUB / NOISE, OSC DRAW, OSC CHOP and FILTER.
VOICE page: MONO, UNISON, POLY or CHORD mode, portamento, transpose, volume. Held: keys 1 and 2 mute tracks A and B, 5 and 6 solo them.
PERFORM page: K1 cutoff, K2 resonance, K3 envelope depth, K4 portamento time.
Two presses save the sound to the active slot. Held, keys 1 to 8 choose the pattern slot.
Held, keys 1 to 16 toggle the steps. The sequencer has two tracks, A and B, of 64 steps.
Sets the tempo to the exact BPM.
Steps through programs 01 to 99. In the sequencer, chooses patterns 1 to 8.
Switches between sequencer track A and track B.

modes.texte: MONO, UNISON (8 stacked voices), POLY (8 voices) and CHORD (stored chord), chosen on GLO's VOICE page.
